column1: # Outcomes of unreadable words of live in the heartbeat live/heartbeats/<name> (V/03.2 Н1.5) for the subsystem readers; a wholly unreadable heartbeat is the Platform family heartbeats. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.

column3: asked of a delivery element not in form: not read, rather than absent — a consumer is taken to exist: a running stream goes on, one not open is opened; the next heartbeat — again
asked_solo not in form: the same
the gateway's heartbeat is unreadable: which streams are asked for is not read: a consumer is taken to exist — a running stream goes on, one not open is opened; the other gateways go on
a delivery element not in form: this gateway does not hold the camera's delivery — it is not called on this pass; another gateway with an element in form is called
the gateway's heartbeat is unreadable: it is not called on this pass; no other gateway — the part waits up to FRAME_WAIT, then offline
asked_solo not in form: exp does not read it — the heartbeat is fit, the gateway is called by status
